subject: Portal evidence canonicalization + SOC2 provenance attestation
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marco Rivera <marco@bluecrest.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portal evidence canonicalization + SOC2 provenance attestation

Marco — thanks again for the time today. Per our call, Bluecrest is asking for a small, canonical package we can upload into your Whistic profile so your procurement and security teams can validate SOC2 artifacts without digging through bundles of mixed PDFs.

Goal: provide a minimal manifest + canonical copies (signed cert, summary AICPA letter, and links to evidence shards) so your side can re-establish proof of possession and map items to SIG questions.

Ask from Bluecrest: a single CSV manifest with stable file IDs and a signed SOC2 certificate file for the profile. Ive copied the team who will coordinate. Proposed deliverables (we can compress if preferred):
- redwood_soc2-cert-2027.pdf (signed, notarized hash)
- evidence-manifest-Bluecrest-202803.csv (file_id, path, evidence_type, short description, related SIG id)
- one-line readme for S3 locations and TTL for ephemeral proofs

Timeline: can we get the manifest + cert by EOD Thursday (Mar 16)? If that is tight, we can stage the CSV first and push the cert next day.

Next steps for us internally: Priyom, can you confirm which evidence fields we should normalize (e.g., "syslog" vs "log_archive") and whether to include both signed and unsigned copies? Ben/Naomi, please note any policy gating items for handing off the cert to an external tenant upload.

Thanks — short signoff so Bluecrest has a clear plan.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Security Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
[rachel.kim@redwood.ai]

Attachment: redwood_soc2-cert-2027.pdf (signed PDF stub, 232KB)
Attachment: evidence-manifest-Bluecrest-202803.csv (CSV stub, 12KB)
From: Marco Rivera <marco@bluecrest.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@bluecrest.com, procurement@bluecrest.com
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 11:05:14 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal evidence canonicalization + SOC2 provenance attestation

Rachel — this looks good and thanks for moving quickly. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

1) For evidence types, our SIG mapping team prefers separate rows for "audit_log" and "system_log" rather than a generic "logs" bucket.
2) Well need a cert chain (PEM or bundled PDF) that includes issuance dates and the CA subject — not just the PDF cover. If you can include the PEM chain as a separate file thatd be ideal.

EOD Thursday is fine, but procurement would like an early preview (CSV only) by Thursday morning to start the internal ticket. Can you do a CSV preview by Thu 09:00 PT?

—Marco
Marco Rivera
Head of Vendor Security, Bluecrest Financial
marco@bluecrest.com

Subject: Re: Portal evidence canonicalization + SOC2 provenance attestation

Thanks — quick technical note from the evidence prep side. For the manifest we'll normalize these fields: file_id, filename, sha256, evidence_type (canonical list), created_at, evidence_owner, related_sig_id.

On the logfile naming, we will split into audit_log and system_log as Marco requested and include a short mapping column (original_path -> canonical_path) so someone uploading to Whistic can reconcile easily.

About the cert chain: Naomi is pulling the PEM chain from the CA vault; Ill add it to the manifest and also include a small verification.txt with the hash of the PEM. Naomi, tagging you to confirm permissions for external upload of the PEM bundle.

—Priyom

Marco — attached is the CSV preview and the PEM chain as requested. Notes:
- CSV includes canonicalized evidence_type and a short mapping column back to original storage paths.
- PEM chain is provided as "redwood_ca_chain_2027.pem" and we included verification.txt (sha256) in the manifest.
- We redacted internal-only environment user names in the CSV; all artifacts have an evidence_owner column showing team aliases for auditability.

Attachments in this message: evidence-manifest-Bluecrest-202803.csv, redwood_ca_chain_2027.pem, verification.txt

If this looks good, well upload the same package to the Whistic profile under "Documents > Signed Artifacts" and let you know the link. Otherwise tell us any final field you want added.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — happy to hop on a 15-min call if procurement/security prefer to walk through the manifest.

—Rachel
